keyEvents.text: Goal! Leyton Orient 1, Harborough Town 0. Armando Dobra (Leyton Orient) header from the left side of the six yard box to the top left corner. Assisted by Fin Stevens.
Rory McAuley (Harborough Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Leyton Orient 2, Harborough Town 0. Aaron Connolly (Leyton Orient) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Alex Gilbert following a set piece situation.
Goal! Leyton Orient 3, Harborough Town 0. Idris El Mizouni (Leyton Orient) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Somto Boniface.
Silvio Bello Olabode (Harborough Town) Substitution at 51'
Silvio Bello (Harborough Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Joshua Walsh (Harborough Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Leyton Orient 3, Harborough Town 1. Paul Malone (Harborough Town) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Eliot Putman.
Kyle Farren Hudlin (Harborough Town) Substitution at 73'
Armando Dobra (Leyton Orient) is shown the yellow card.
Alfie Gilchrist (Leyton Orient) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Leyton Orient 4, Harborough Town 1. Tony Springett (Leyton Orient) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
